name: M&J Frank Inc.
old_description: M&J Frank has been selling quality restaurant supplies since 1939. We are a third generation business that has throughout the years maintained an extremely high level of service. From the tabletop to the bar, from the kitchen to the washroom, M&J can help solve all of your needs . For over 80 years in New Jersey, we have served the public and the food service industry with courteous, friendly service and the finest restaurant equipment brand names available.  Our loyal customers have not only enjoyed our vast selection of foodservice essentials, but they've also experienced the difference that quality and service can make. We’re dedicated to helping you in your culinary endeavors and are excited to be a part of your success story.
about:
M&J Frank Inc. operates from East Hanover, New Jersey, where it was founded in 1939. The business remains a third-generation, family-owned operation that has served the food-service market in the Garden State for more than eight decades.

The company stocks and distributes a broad range of restaurant equipment, smallwares, disposable products, and janitorial supplies. Its showroom and warehouse at 29 Eagle Rock Avenue carry brand-name lines for the tabletop, bar, kitchen, and washroom, functioning as a one-stop supply source rather than a fabrication shop.

Primary customers include independent restaurants, chefs, catering operations, institutional food-service buyers, and home cooks throughout New Jersey and the surrounding region. The firm emphasizes walk-in and phone-order service for both large-scale kitchen outfitting and day-to-day consumable replenishment.

Leadership points to the continuity of family ownership and a service-first approach as the reasons the business has endured since the late 1930s, citing long-standing relationships with both suppliers and local operators.
